transcript.sourceText: THE CORE IDEA
transcript.text: THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Prices coordinate decentralized decisions by communicating scarcity and changing the incentives facing buyers and sellers. Information about waiting costs can redirect users much like a price signal. A higher price raises the cost of consuming the good and encourages substitution or conservation. A higher price communicates stronger scarcity or demand pressure and encourages supply responses. A supply improvement can lower price by reducing the good’s relative scarcity.

transcript.text: WORKED EXAMPLE: USING A PRICE SIGNAL

runs.text: A shortage develops at the current market price. Buyers compete for the limited units, putting upward pressure on price. As price rises, quantity demanded falls and quantity supplied rises, reducing the shortage. The price signal helps coordinate buyers and sellers without a central allocation decision.

THE CORE IDEA

Prices coordinate decentralized decisions by communicating scarcity and changing the incentives facing buyers and sellers. Information about waiting costs can redirect users much like a price signal. A higher price raises the cost of consuming the good and encourages substitution or conservation. A higher price communicates stronger scarcity or demand pressure and encourages supply responses. A supply improvement can lower price by reducing the good’s relative scarcity.
HOW TO RECOGNIZE IT
A higher price discourages quantity demanded and encourages quantity supplied.
Improved production technology can reduce scarcity and lower price.
A legal ceiling can prevent price adjustment and leave a shortage.
WATCH OUT

A common mistake is to assume that a higher price always tells buyers and sellers to do the same thing. It discourages quantity demanded while encouraging quantity supplied, coordinating opposite responses.
WORKED EXAMPLE: USING A PRICE SIGNAL

A shortage develops at the current market price. Buyers compete for the limited units, putting upward pressure on price. As price rises, quantity demanded falls and quantity supplied rises, reducing the shortage. The price signal helps coordinate buyers and sellers without a central allocation decision.
